_comment: Hand-kept fixes for gaps in Teamcraft data. Each entry notes its source.

2412.name: Shirogane
2412.source: Housing district added in patch 4.1 (Stormblood); TerritoryType.ExVersion says ARR

7686.name: Gigantshark
7686.source: Player, 2026-11-08: mooched from Merlthor Goby, Harbor Herring or Ogre Barracuda (ffxiv.consolegameswiki.com/wiki/Gigantshark lists Merlthor Goby and Ogre Barracuda)
